name: Paludal-Obelisk
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past an ancient meteor crater, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on water and dark crystals are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
